comment.title: Redis clients never reconnect after a disconnect
comment.body: Disabling retries leaves the cached client disconnected, so later requests fail until restart. Return a capped backoff instead.
comment.why: The reconnect callback returns null and no replacement client is created.
comment.verification: Traced CacheStore.get to client.get and confirmed the error path has no reconnect.
comment.agent_prompt: Verify the reconnect behavior, restore capped retry backoff, and add a disconnect regression test.

comment.title: Legacy webhooks accept signatures from a different tenant
comment.body: The legacy route verifies the global key rather than the tenant key, allowing a signed payload to cross tenant boundaries.
comment.why: The lookup ignores the authenticated tenant.
comment.verification: Send a tenant A signature to a tenant B webhook and confirm rejection after the fix.
comment.agent_prompt: Check the legacy webhook key lookup, bind verification to the current tenant, and cover cross-tenant rejection.
